name: Yatsurugi Komachi
source:
A member of the Kendo club, known for her strength and feared by many because of it. Has a very old-fashioned way of thinking. Makito becomes acquainted with her while undertaking a Harvest OnReal quest. Once she discovers that Makito was a renowned Cherry Blossom player known as Dark Paladin, she appears to hold a grudge against him.

[spoiler]It turns out that Makito and Komachi were married in Cherry Blossom. While Makito viewed it as solely an in-game affair, Komachi took it more seriously and desired to meet him in real life and get married for real. She became furious when Makito never went online again, thinking that he had betrayed her.[/spoiler]
